comment: Independent shk.c probe in a general store: a debug-mode Valkyrie level-teleports to Dlvl 2, where this seed lands her inside Maganasipi's store, and sells ten identified diamonds so the shopkeeper has no gold (shk_chat 'business is bad'). Glob drops then exercise globby_bill_fixup(): a declined credit offer leaves a no_charge glob (sellobj quit), an accepted one a shop-owned glob, and further globs add to credit, pay part of and then all of a wand-of-fire engraving usage fee (shk_chat debit reminder, dopay debt partly offset by credit); picking up shop globs merges two billed globs in the pack (scenario 1, unpaid absorber), a wished glob joins the unpaid one, dropping the unpaid glob onto the no_charge glob makes the keeper bill for the mix (scenario 3), dropping an unpaid glob onto a shop-owned glob covers scenario 1 without an absorber bill, and an own glob dropped onto the no_charge glob is scenario 4.
